Settings.ModelDescription: Scribe v2 is used for file transcription; live dictation uses Scribe v2 Realtime.
Settings.TranscriptionModeDescription: Automatic streams in real time when live transcription allows it. REST only always uploads the whole recording, which avoids real-time concurrency limits.
Settings.NoVerbatim: Clean up filler words and verbal stumbles
Settings.NoVerbatimDescription: Applies to real-time and REST transcription. Combined with audio events, ElevenLabs decides which annotations remain.
Settings.TagAudioEvents: Include audio events such as [coughs] and [mouse clicks]
Manifest.Name: ElevenLabs
Manifest.Description: Cloud transcription via ElevenLabs Scribe with real-time WebSocket streaming
